name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Provides free health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to vulnerable families.
detailed_eligibility: Low-income households, unorganized workers, families living in one-room kutcha houses, landless labor, or families listed in the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides interest subsidies on home loans or direct cash assistance to construct or purchase a permanent house in urban or rural areas.
detailed_eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS, income < ₹3 Lakh/year) or Low Income Group (LIG, income < ₹6 Lakh/year) families who do not own a pucca house in India.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized sector workers to secure their retirement years with a monthly financial payout.
detailed_eligibility: Unorganized workers (street vendors, domestic helpers, construction workers, etc.) aged 18 to 40 years with a monthly income under ₹15,000, not enrolled in EPFO, ESIC, or NPS.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides income support of ₹6,000 per year directly to the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across the country.
detailed_eligibility: Small and marginal landholding farmer families who own cultivable land in their names (subject to certain institutional/high-income exclusions).

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PM-GKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
description: Distributes free food grains (wheat, rice, or coarse grains) to poor households to ensure nutritional security for lower-income families.
benefit_amount: 5 kg free food grains / person / month
detailed_eligibility: Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cardholders registered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A high-interest savings and investment scheme designed to secure the financial future of girl children, covering education and marriage costs.
detailed_eligibility: Opened by a parent or legal guardian in the name of a girl child who is under the age of 10 years (maximum 2 accounts per family).

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: A special micro-credit scheme providing working capital loans to street vendors to help them resume their livelihoods post-pandemic.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation
detailed_eligibility: Urban street vendors vending on or before March 24, 2020, holding a valid Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free working capital or capital loans to micro and small non-farm businesses (manufacturing, trading, and services).
detailed_eligibility: Proprietors, partners, or micro-enterprises running non-farm income-generating small businesses seeking credit up to ₹10 Lakhs.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: A pension scheme providing monthly financial support to elderly citizens living in households below the poverty line.
detailed_eligibility: Citizens aged 60 years or above who belong to a household officially living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
